images.caption: Figure 1:Reformulating generation as representation learning.Conventional unified models optimize synthesis-oriented targets, whereas UMM-JEPA directly predicts continuous visual-understanding representations through progressive coarse-to-fine construction. Pixel rendering is decoupled from core representation pretraining.

Figure 2:Overview of UMM-JEPA.Understanding and representation generation share a single multimodal backbone. Understanding uses language-modeling supervision, while generation progressively predicts frozen perceptual representations from coarse to fine. Pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward through a separately trained connector and pretrained diffusion renderer.

Figure 3:Progressive masked representation prediction.Each parent predicts four child representations at the next scale under
frozen-teacher supervision, conditioned on ground-truth visual states during
training and on recursively reused predictions at inference. Masking trains
missing-context recovery and coarse-to-fine refinement.
Figure 5:Progressive generation for four prompts. Each sequence is rendered at scales6464,128128,256256, and512512. Coarse scales set the layout; later scales add detail. Illustrative only.
